grain: realized lot (closing event x opening event)

columns.name: firm
columns.meaning: the registry-derived firm scope this row belongs to; never a typed token

columns.name: account_id
columns.meaning: the custodian account id in the declaration's account form (10-char zero-padded)

columns.name: business_date
columns.meaning: the lot's closing date, the custodian's own

columns.name: lot_id
columns.meaning: the closing event id and the opening event id joined by '/': unique on every partition measured; a repeat refuses

columns.name: ticker_symbol
columns.meaning: the custodian's ticker, blank where it carries none

columns.name: cusip
columns.meaning: the security's CUSIP, blank where it carries none

columns.name: quantity
columns.meaning: the quantity of this lot that closed

columns.name: acquired_date
columns.meaning: the lot's acquired date as the custodian states it; null on ACQUIRED_DATE_ABSENT. A date before 2010 is kept, never estimated or altered

columns.name: holding_term
columns.meaning: the custodian's holding-term flag read through the producer's declared map

columns.name: holding_trading_days
columns.meaning: trading days in [acquired_date, business_date] by lib/trading_calendar.py; null on PRE_2010_OPENED (the calendar raises before 2010) and on ACQUIRED_DATE_ABSENT

columns.name: proceeds
columns.meaning: the lot's closing proceeds, net of the trade's fees, as the custodian states them

columns.name: cost_basis
columns.meaning: cost_basis_unamortized -- the column satisfying proceeds - cost_basis == realized_gain, chosen by measurement

columns.name: realized_gain
columns.meaning: the custodian's own gain_loss_dollars for the lot

columns.name: closing_tie
columns.meaning: the lot's relation to its closing transaction in the custodian's transactions; the reason where it does not tie

columns.name: method_version
columns.meaning: the method this figure was produced under (1)

columns.name: coverage
columns.meaning: why a calendar-derived column is null; MEASURED where none is

i_mece_over_a_declared_domain.coverage: domain: 'why is a calendar-derived column of this lot null'. MEASURED (none is) | PRE_2010_OPENED (the lot was opened before lib/trading_calendar.py's floor of 2010-01-01, which raises there: holding_trading_days is null and the custodian's dates are kept) | ACQUIRED_DATE_ABSENT (the custodian row has no acquired date). COVERED BY SUBTRACTION: a lot either carries an acquired date or not; one that does is either on or after the floor or before it.
i_mece_over_a_declared_domain.closing_tie: domain: 'does this realized lot tie to its closing transaction in the custodian's transactions'. TIED | NO_ORDER_NUMBER (the lot carries no order number to look one up by) | NO_TRADE_FOR_ORDER (no trade row for this account, order and security in the searched partitions) | TRADE_DATE_DIFFERS (the trade is not on the lot's closing date) | QUANTITY_DIFFERS (the order's lots do not sum to the trade's quantity) | PROCEEDS_DIFFER (they do not sum to its net amount). COVERED BY SUBTRACTION in the producer's order: an order number exists or not; a trade exists or not; it is on the date or not; the quantities agree or not; the proceeds agree or not. A lot is tied or untied WITH the other lots of its order, because one trade closes against several lots and only their sum is the trade.
i_mece_over_a_declared_domain.holding_term: domain: the custodian's holding-term flag. LONG_TERM | SHORT_TERM. A flag outside the declared map REFUSES: it is a defect, not a third member.

rule24_record.ii_same_grain: Every member of coverage and closing_tie is a LOT property; holding_term is a lot property; none is an account property.
rule24_record.iii_intent_coherence: closing_tie answers ONE question -- the lot's relation to its closing transaction. coverage answers a different one -- why a calendar-derived column is null -- and neither says whether the gain is right.
rule24_record.iv_state_coherence: WHICH VALUES ONE REMEDY DOES NOT MOVE. A transaction partition landing late moves NO_TRADE_FOR_ORDER only. The calendar gaining pre-2010 coverage moves PRE_2010_OPENED only. Neither moves the other axis.

schema_hash_basis: sha256 over the sorted 'name:type' lines joined by newline, types as the pyarrow type name the producer's ARROW_* schema carries -- the method that reproduces account_return_daily's published hash 1b25d37b... exactly. The check recomputes it against the landed parquet, so contract and artifact cannot drift.
firm_specific_columns: NONE. No Schwab code survives into this table (no tr_cd, sb_cd, h_t, l_s, close_event_id column); the custodian's lot-table and column names live only in the producer's LOT_SOURCE adapter block, which row IRPT_DASHBD-W20-S1 asks to move into sources.json.
producer_pin: data/assets/scripts/gold/irpt_reporting/account_activity_lots.py -- the ARROW_REALIZED schema this hash is taken from. The producer and this contract land together.
limits_of_method_version_1: method_version 1: one row per custodian realized-lot row; the tie is a lookup by account, order number and security against the TRADE rows of the searched transaction partitions; a lot closed by an event with no order number (an expiry, an assignment) ties NOTHING and says so.
